race.comment: Tricky but DENY ENTRY (5) might be able to measure up. He didn't fire on debut but returned with a dominant victory at Cranbourne at big odds, sweeping away late to score by 2.5 lengths on heavy ground. Has clearly come back better and can run another strong race at each way odds. ZEBRA FINCH (3) has been contesting strong 3yo races over the Winter, good to the line behind Clevor Trever in the Silver Bowl Final two back before another sound effort last time. This looks a lovely race for him. TWO SIGMA (10) has been mixing her form but comes right into calculations now after some key scratchings. Rises to a winning trip on the quick turnaround. Can give this a big shake. MORNING DARLING (1) next.
